items.title: How These 3 Top Funds Deliver ‘Deep Value’ With Fewer Tech Stocks
items.summary: Look at the largest holdings of some of the most popular value funds and you might be surprised.  The average fund in  Morningstar’s  Large Value category now has 18% of its portfolio in tech stocks that look expensive by classic valuation metrics.  Benjamin Graham and David Dodd, the authors of the famous tome Security Analysis, believed investors should buy stocks trading below book value, an asset-based measure of a company’s net worth on its balance sheet.
